hooks.command: echo '夜跑中。硬规则:禁 push/merge/tag/publish;禁改 oracle/fixture/threshold;每个修复必须有前后同一条命令的真实输出。进度写 PROGRESS.md,证据写 NIGHT_RUN_LEDGER.md。'

hooks.prompt: Unattended overnight run on agent-audit. Check the transcript. (1) Does NIGHT_RUN_LEDGER.md contain, for every claimed fix, a BEFORE and an AFTER block running the SAME command with real pasted output? (2) Has NIGHT_RUN_REPORT.md been written? (3) Did it avoid push/merge/tag/publish and avoid editing any oracle, fixture, dataset, or threshold? If work remains in the W0-W5 queue and no blocking NEEDS-HEADY reason was logged, it should keep going. Respond {"ok": false, "reason": "<what is missing or what to do next>"} if any check fails, otherwise {"ok": true}.
